objective: Best tested quality-constrained hyperparameters per method, then individual winners combined versus a predeclared untuned combination
precision: FP32 stored weights, FP16 autocast; TF32 disabled
lora_selection: Lowest uncached eager inference latency among candidates within 0.02 validation NLL of the best grid candidate; report training speed separately
cache_policy: Dynamic full-context K/V cache, no eviction or quantization; chunk size controls prefill only
fa_implementation: Existing FA1-derived Triton Algorithms 1/4 prototype; not original FA1 CUDA library or PyTorch FA2
runtime_quality_gate: Tensor parity against FP64 eager; FA and cache validation NLL within 0.02 of eager; cache same-input last-prefill logits atol 0.1/rtol 0.02. Preserve greedy-token divergences.
combined: Freeze individual winners before seven fresh paired confirmation runs and held-out test evaluation. Keep all three methods enabled for both configurations. No joint retuning.
interpretation: Untuned baseline is predeclared, not chosen as the worst. It may win. A single seed and finite grid cannot establish global optimality. Search cost excluded and not assumed amortized.
protocol_amendment: After first runtime sweep found FP16 chunk-dependent greedy-token divergence, replaced bitwise token parity with logit and validation-likelihood checks before confirmation/test. Completed training reused unchanged.
